entries.title: Kata product identity and release ownership
entries.retainedOutcome: Shipped product names, package scope, CLI, state ownership, release workflows, and hosted identity remain Kata-owned.

entries.title: Portable Kata brand assets
entries.retainedOutcome: Portable icon and web asset families resolve to Kata artwork and remain distinct by release channel.

entries.title: Kata Connect wire identity
entries.retainedOutcome: Connect protocol names, endpoints, and relay resource identifiers remain the Kata wire contract.

entries.title: Kata state and environment isolation
entries.retainedOutcome: Desktop state paths and environment selection remain isolated under Kata-owned directories and protocols.

entries.title: Sandbox preview default and settings registration
entries.retainedOutcome: Sandbox preview remains registered in settings while disabled by default and available through the explicit Kata override.

entries.title: Sandbox route and provider driver registration
entries.retainedOutcome: Sandbox routes and provider instance drivers remain registered together without enabling the default preview.

entries.title: Provider and sandbox environment isolation
entries.retainedOutcome: Sandbox bootstrap credentials are stripped before provider launch and provider home configuration remains isolated.

entries.title: Kata migration identity and upstream upgrade ordering
entries.retainedOutcome: Applied Kata migration IDs remain stable and incoming upstream operations run once at unoccupied IDs.

entries.title: Retained process and VCS behavior
entries.retainedOutcome: Kata process execution and VCS binary handling remain stable while provider environment boundaries are checked separately.

entries.title: Retained web and mobile Kata behaviors
entries.retainedOutcome: Retained web settings identity and mobile branding behavior remain Kata-specific after upstream UI changes.

entries.title: Mobile shelf preference identity and defaults
entries.retainedOutcome: Kata shelf preference keys and settled-expanded defaults remain stable without compatibility reads.

entries.title: Mobile Markdown image lifecycle and bounds
entries.retainedOutcome: Kata image lifecycle guards, dimensions, captions, and media behavior survive the upstream extraction.

entries.title: Mobile pairing credential redaction
entries.retainedOutcome: Pairing credentials remain redacted while mobile pairing retains Kata schemes and hosts.

entries.title: Desktop Clerk and environment identity
entries.retainedOutcome: Desktop Clerk bootstrap and Kata state/environment identity survive upstream lifecycle changes.

entries.title: Desktop protocol and bundle identity
entries.retainedOutcome: Desktop bundle, display, protocol, and scheme identities remain Kata-owned.

entries.title: Desktop URL handler and backend environment routes
entries.retainedOutcome: Kata URL handlers and /.well-known/kata/environment backend routes remain registered.

entries.title: Desktop browser session namespace isolation
entries.retainedOutcome: Persistent Kata browser storage remains separate from ephemeral preview sessions.

entries.title: Desktop update recovery and reservation behavior
entries.retainedOutcome: Desktop update installation and recovery retain restart and reservation guarantees.

entries.title: Desktop window lifecycle and reveal behavior
entries.retainedOutcome: Window event listeners, reveal state, and lifecycle cleanup remain retained Kata behavior.

entries.title: Desktop packaging, signing, and retained asset identity
entries.retainedOutcome: Signed desktop packaging keeps Kata assets, scoped release identity, and signing safeguards.

entries.title: Kata release package and asset ownership
entries.retainedOutcome: Release package metadata, installer names, and update-version tooling remain scoped to Kata-owned package and workflow identities.

entries.title: Desktop launcher identity and development environment
entries.retainedOutcome: Desktop launcher bundle, display, protocol, scheme, and development-root identities remain Kata-owned.

entries.title: Desktop Kata asset resolution
entries.retainedOutcome: Desktop asset resolution keeps Kata icon resources and does not silently select upstream source-tree artwork.

entries.title: Desktop Linux keyring wording and behavior
entries.retainedOutcome: Linux keyring remediation and its visible Kata wording remain stable for supported desktop secret-storage paths.

entries.title: Mobile Android asset and config identity
entries.retainedOutcome: Android config variants keep Kata package and configured asset paths; artwork acceptance remains a separate live check.

entries.title: Mobile Android asset artwork evidence
entries.retainedOutcome: Android artwork is inspected on a supported device or asset review surface; the pre-existing monochrome asset defect remains linked to KAT-3301.

entries.title: Mobile Android FAB and measured inset behavior
entries.retainedOutcome: Android home FAB clearance and measured inset reset preserve the final sidebar row and safe-area spacing.

entries.title: Mobile project clone URL behavior
entries.retainedOutcome: Mobile project thread creation keeps the Kata project clone URL selection and selected-workspace behavior.

entries.title: Mobile remote agent-awareness teardown
entries.retainedOutcome: Mobile remote agent-awareness registration is released when its connection and live activity lifecycle ends.

entries.title: Mobile theme and native identity
entries.retainedOutcome: Generated mobile themes and Android Material You overrides retain Kata theme labels and palette semantics.

entries.title: macOS Icon Composer output
entries.retainedOutcome: Icon Composer output is inspected on macOS and remains Kata artwork with the required dimensions and safe area.

entries.title: Human review of device and provider behavior
entries.retainedOutcome: Human Review confirms the live browser, device, and provider surfaces that static checks cannot exercise.
